validity.recommendation: Change Owner1 from 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) to the National Iranian Gas Company / Khorasan Razavi Gas Company (NIGC subsidiary); and fix FuelSource, which currently names the destination (steel plant) rather than the gas source (national trunk / North-Northeast line).
validity.researcher_notes: Two clear attribution errors. (1) OWNER: GEM lists Owner1 = 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) at 100%. All domestic gas transmission/distribution and industrial gas-supply lines in Iran are operated by the National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC) and its provincial subsidiaries; NIOC is the upstream oil/E&P company and does not own domestic gas-supply feeders. A short feeder to a steel plant in Razavi Khorasan would fall under NIGC / Sherkat-e Gaz-e Ostan-e Khorasan Razavi (Khorasan Razavi Gas Co). NIOC is structurally wrong here. (2) FUELSOURCE: GEM sets FuelSource = 'Sabzevar Steel Plant' — but the steel plant is the END CONSUMER, not the gas source. The gas source is the national grid / the North-Northeast (2nd) trunk that passes through Sabzevar (GEM P6026) or the Esfarayen-Neqab-Joghatai reinforcement line. FuelSource is reversed. Independent evidence that the plant exists and is gas-fed: NICC (Nasir Energy Gostar), the EPC contractor, lists the Sabzevar steel EPC (employer National Iranian Steel Company, 800,000 t/y DRI/EAF, operating from 2017-18) and its Persian project page notes implementation of the incoming gas line to the factory; Khwarizmi lists SPSCO / Pars Folad Sabzevar in Jovein, 50 km Sabzevar-Esfarayen road, Razavi Khorasan. Neither names 'National Iranian Oil Co' as owner.

validity.recommendation: Downgrade support / attach a source that actually names this line. The plant is real and gas-fed, but the specific 3.5 km / 12-in 'Sabzevar Steel Plant Gas Pipeline' has no independent source naming it or confirming its specs.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE caveat, not a phantom. The plant physically exists and consumes gas (DRI/EAF steelmaking needs gas), and NICC's Persian project page references the incoming gas line to the factory — so a feeder to the plant almost certainly exists. BUT the row's specs are unsupported: the ONLY gem.wiki outbound citation for this row is the Iran Ertebat page for the 'construction-of-reinforcing-gas-pipeline-transmission-in-esfarayen-neghab-joghtay' project (the Esfarayen-Neqab-Joghatai reinforcement line) — the SAME URL cited by P6022, P6023 and P6024. That citation does not name Sabzevar Steel Plant and does not support a 3.5 km / 12-in figure. No independent source found that names this pipeline as a discrete asset or confirms LengthKnown=3.5 km or Diameter=12 in. GulfPub PE World Map (49 Iran gas features) has NO counterpart for this plant feeder. Treat length/diameter as GEM-internal/unverified.

validity.recommendation: Consider whether a 3.5 km / 12-in single-consumer plant feeder belongs in GEM as PipelineType=transmission; it functions as a branch/feeder (ansheab) line, not a trunk.
validity.researcher_notes: CLASSIFICATION caveat. GEM tags PipelineType=transmission, but a 3.5 km, 12-inch line dedicated to feeding one industrial consumer (the Sabzevar/Jovein steel complex) is a branch/feeder line off the trunk, not a transmission trunk. Regional coverage (Khorasan Razavi Gas Co reporting) describes such lines as branches/reinforcements to industry. It is genuinely gas (Fuel=Gas — steel DRI plants run on natural gas, consistent), so not a wrong-commodity error; the caveat is trunk-vs-feeder granularity. NOT a duplicate: no other Iran gas operating row or GulfPub feature represents this 3.5 km plant feeder (P6022/P6023 Esfarayen-Neqab-Joghatai, P6021 Torbat Heydariyeh-Kashmar, P6026 North-Northeast trunk are distinct assets that merely share the same Iran Ertebat citation family).

routes.corridor_desc: Short (~3.5 km) feeder spur serving the Sabzevar Pars Steel complex, which sits in Jovein district about 50 km from Sabzevar along the Sabzevar-Esfarayen road, Razavi Khorasan. The line taps the national gas grid — most plausibly the North-Northeast (2nd) trunk that passes through the Sabzevar area (GEM P6026) or the nearby Esfarayen-Neqab-Joghatai reinforcement corridor — and runs to the plant intake. GEM's current endpoints (start='Asia', end='Asia') are placeholders and carry no geographic information. Bound is LOOSE: the destination (steel complex, Jovein) is well established from NICC and Khwarizmi, but the exact tap point and the 3.5 km alignment are not independently sourced. No coordinates are asserted because none could be sourced without fabrication.
routes.researcher_notes: Destination fixed to the Sabzevar Pars Steel complex in Jovein (50 km Sabzevar-Esfarayen road, Razavi Khorasan) via Khwarizmi (SPSCO location) and NICC (EPC of the plant, employer National Iranian Steel Company). The gas source is the national trunk near Sabzevar; exact tap unsourced. Coordinates deliberately left null — the plant's precise lat/lon could not be sourced and are NOT fabricated. Sabzevar city (~36.2N, 57.7E) and Jovein (northwest of Sabzevar) bound the corridor only loosely.

summary: P6025 concern: NIOC owner and reversed FuelSource (attribution), unsourced 3.5km/12in specs cited only to an unrelated Esfarayen-Neqab-Joghatai page (existence caveat), and single-plant feeder tagged as transmission (classification caveat); plant real and gas-fed; not a duplicate; route destination = Sabzevar Pars Steel, Jovein — low.
